title: Outlier AI Pay by Language: $10 to $31 for the Same Job #Shorts
description:
On page two of Outlier's public opportunities board, one job title appears seven times: Voice Conversation Evaluator. Same title, same skill. The only thing that changes is the language - Thai up to $10/hr, English up to $15, Italian and Chinese up to $20, French up to $25, German up to $29, Korean up to $31. Every figure is an "Up to" - a ceiling, not a promise. Their FAQ adds that rates vary by expertise, project complexity, and location.

Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLUk6lyoyyRc
Full breakdown of how Outlier works: https://youtu.be/d2uTolb3NV4
Source: app.outlier.ai/opportunities - read on the day this was recorded.

Nothing here is a guarantee of work, acceptance, or income.
